title: Scroll morph between point clouds sampled from SVG shapes, on a 2D canvas
summary: Points sampled from rasterised SVGs, projected in JS with a horizontal fov and drawn far to near in 16 depth buckets; scroll picks the shape pair with 18 % holds, a sin²(πe) mid-morph swirl, a segment-change burst and a pointer repel; paint skipped when settled; opacity cross-fade under reduced motion
variants: Canvas 2D with JS projection (this): no GPU, a few thousand points
WebGL points (three.js Points or a raw gl.POINTS draw) when the count passes ten thousand; targets in a float texture, blend in the vertex shader
Slot re-matching: a spatial hash that hands a scattered point the nearest free target instead of its fixed one
